product_overview: A WhatsApp-focused CRM app that lets merchants connect Shopify in Settings so the AI can reference product catalogs, orders, and tracking information. Merchants can then test the AI agent’s Shopify-aware auto-replies from the Agents playground.
core_goals: Sign in to access the CRM workspace
Connect a Shopify store from Settings
Enable Shopify data for WhatsApp auto-replies
Sync the Shopify catalog after a valid connection
Test the AI agent with Shopify-related product or order questions

features.name: User Login
features.description: Users sign in with their workspace email and password to access the authenticated CRM area.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Enter email address -> Enter password -> Submit the sign-in form -> See the dashboard

features.name: Shopify Settings Connection
features.description: Users connect a Shopify custom app in Settings so the app can use store data for catalog lookup, orders, and tracking.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Enter email address -> Enter password -> Submit the sign-in form -> Navigate to /settings -> Open the Shopify section -> Enter shop domain -> Enter Admin API access token -> Optionally enter WhatsApp catalog ID -> Enable Shopify in auto-reply -> Save the connection -> See store details populated and catalog sync become available

Navigate to /login -> Enter email address -> Enter password -> Submit the sign-in form -> Navigate to /settings -> Open the Shopify section -> Enter shop domain -> Leave the Admin API access token empty or invalid -> Save the connection -> See an error message and no successful save state

Navigate to /login -> Enter email address -> Enter password -> Submit the sign-in form -> Navigate to /settings -> Open the Shopify section -> Connect a valid store -> Start catalog sync -> See the catalog sync complete

features.name: AI Agents Shopify Playground
features.description: Users test the WhatsApp AI agent by sending product or order questions and observing Shopify-aware responses.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Enter email address -> Enter password -> Submit the sign-in form -> Navigate to /agents -> Open the AI Agents playground -> Send a test message about products or orders -> See the agent respond with Shopify-aware information

routes.description: Workspace settings including Shopify store connection

features.name: Shopify settings
features.description: Connect a Shopify custom app so WhatsApp AI can look up catalog, orders, tracking, and send buy links
user_interactions: Click Shopify in the rail or overview tile
Enter shop domain and Admin API token

features.name: AI Agents playground
features.description: Test the auto-reply agent including Shopify tools
user_interactions: Send a test chat message about products or orders

known_limitations.issue: Shopify is not connected until a merchant pastes a shpat_ Admin API token
known_limitations.impact: Catalog sync and live order lookup stay disabled

known_limitations.issue: Overview tile currently shows Shopify as not set up
known_limitations.impact: Expected until a valid Admin token is saved
